ai_summary: Anthem Biosciences Limited has settled an upside sharing arrangement, resulting in a material cash outflow of approximately INR 1,276.83 million. This significant payment, stemming from a divestment by Viridity Tone LLP, was made to specific "Upside Principal Shareholders," indicating a substantial distribution of funds to key insiders. While the company states the settlement was approved by public shareholders and in compliance with SEBI regulations, the large payout to principal shareholders warrants further scrutiny regarding potential value transfer.
